signals.title: @robbi_fahey: This is chilling. Mo Gawdat (former senior Google X exec) just said what most active tech leaders won’t: what’s happening inside the labs is
signals.content: This is chilling. Mo Gawdat (former senior Google X exec) just said what most active tech leaders won’t: what’s happening inside the labs is genuinely world-changing and mostly hidden. The real work is going into autonomous weapons, military targeting systems, real-time surveillance, and self-improving code that rewrites itself without human oversight. His blunt assessment: “As we speak, we are living in two major wars where AI is doing most of the killing.” He pointed to Palantir CEO Alex Karp openly celebrating how their targeting technology identifies and eliminates people. He also referenced Sam Altman (CEO of OpenAI) saying he suspects AI is likely to end humanity, but that they’ll create a lot of interesting companies along the way. (Anthropic refused a large military contract involving human targeting and surveillance and was blacklisted. OpenAI stepped in.) Gawdat’s near-term prediction: war, economic disruption, mass unemployment as AI takes over large categories of work, expanded surveillance, and extreme concentration of power. Ordinary people lose livelihoods while decisions and control shift away from human hands. The question is whether we’re paying attention before the job losses and power shift become irreversible. https://t.co/MMWBl7ButQ
